stem_md: 设向量场 $A=\{y\ln z,z,\ln y\}$，则 $A$ 的旋度 $\operatorname{rot}A=$（ ）
analysis_md:
解析：$\frac{\partial\ln y}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial z}{\partial z}=\frac{1-y}{y},\quad \frac{\partial(y\ln z)}{\partial z}-\frac{\partial\ln y}{\partial x}=\frac{y}{z},\quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial(y\ln z)}{\partial y}=-\ln z$，

∴ $\operatorname{rot}A=\left\{\frac{1-y}{y},\frac{y}{z},\ln\frac{1}{z}\right\}$。
search_text:
设向量场 $A=\{y\ln z,z,\ln y\}$，则 $A$ 的旋度 $\operatorname{rot}A=$（ ） $\{\frac1y,\frac yz,-\ln z\}$ $\{\frac{1-y}{y},\frac yz,\ln\frac1z\}$ $\{\frac{1-y}{y},\frac1z,-\ln z\}$ $\{\frac1y-1,\frac yz,\ln z\}$ 解析：$\frac{\partial\ln y}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial z}{\partial z}=\frac{1-y}{y},\quad \frac{\partial(y\ln z)}{\partial z}-\frac{\partial\ln y}{\partial x}=\frac{y}{z},\quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial(y\ln z)}{\partial y}=-\ln z$，

∴ $\operatorname{rot}A=\left\{\frac{1-y}{y},\frac{y}{z},\ln\frac{1}{z}\right\}$。
